saints.name: Jacob Netsvetov
saints.sourceTitle: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

summary.text: Jacob Netsvetov is remembered as a missionary priest of Alaska with Russian and Aleut family roots. The OCA life describes his education, family, pastoral travels, translation, and ministry under difficult conditions. His record gives the Saints section a connection with Indigenous North American Christian history. Miraculous and devotional elements remain attributed to the complete published account.

blocks.text: Jacob was born on Atka in 1802 to a Russian father and an Aleut mother. He studied at Irkutsk, married Anna, and was ordained.

blocks.text: Long journeys marked his Alaskan ministry. After his wife’s death, a fire, and his father’s death, he continued missionary service, eventually leading the Kvikhpak mission.
